spec.description: Every product of one type the service still holds, newest first. Header fields only.

type_id.description: Three-letter product type, such as `AFD`. `products.list_product_types` names every code.

response.description: The products, newest first, without their text.

notes: Not filterable and not paged. The OpenAPI declares no query parameter here, and the service does not ignore one it was not told about: `/products/types/AFD?limit=3` answered 200 with an empty `@graph` (measured 2026-09-30). The response stops at 5000 products: `CF6` answered exactly 5000, `AFD` 4579 reaching back to 2026-09-14. For a span or a limit use `products.list_products` with `type`.
